header.notes: sha256 is of the raw source PDF (n-25-67.pdf). HSA amounts are from Rev. Proc. 2025-19 (https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-drop/rp-25-19.pdf, sha256 ff2ba4bac62ef6940c57578d70f8be88ff3898ac806e921ad52787c11da35bf4); hsa.catchUp55 is statutory (IRC 223(b)(3)). rothCatchUpWageThreshold is the 2025-wages threshold ($150,000) that governs 2026 catch-up contributions. sep.limit equals the 415(c) limit; sep.pctOfCompensation is statutory (25% of compensation; effectively 20% of net self-employment earnings). simple.limit is the standard limit ($18,100 applies to certain small-employer plans; their age-50 catch-up is $3,850). Roth and traditional IRA MFS ranges are statutory ($0-$10,000, not indexed). 529-to-Roth: $35,000 lifetime, account open 15 years (IRC 529(c)(3)(E)); annual rollovers are also capped at the IRA limit. I-bond cap: $10,000 electronic per SSN per calendar year (TreasuryDirect; paper bonds via tax refund ended 2025).
